In article <4lo13m$m...@hptemp1.cc.umr.edu>,

Jesse Chounard <jes...@rocket.cc.umr.edu> wrote:
>What is the current restricted list?
>And how many of each card are we restricted to?

Restricted list (only applies to DCI-sanctioned tournaments,
official play has no restrictions):

Six each of the following:
* Ancilla Empowerment
* Conservitive Agitation
* Domain Challenge
* Earth Meld
* Fifth Tradition: Hospitality
* Form of Mist
* Freak Drive
* Kine Resources Contested
* Majesty
* Parity Shift
* Sabbat Threat

Banned list (same disclaimer):

* Cunctator Motion
* High Stakes
* Rowan Ring
* Stake
* Monocle of Clarity
* Playing For Keeps (Dark Sovereigns)

This information is from aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Tue Jan 16 13:21:58 EST 1996
(Tom Wylie) on rec.games.trading-cards.announce.

That posting is available from Alec Habig's archive:
ftp://bigbang.astro.indiana.edu/pub/jyhad/tourny.rules

But, as usual, the official WotC VtES page is missing this information.
